source_title: American Time Use Survey 2025 Activity Coding Lexicon

mappings.description: Proxy estimate from ATUS tier-one 05 work episodes
assumptions: ATUS records work time but does not classify whether its outcome was good or bad.

mappings.description: ATUS eating episodes starting from 04:00 through 10:59
assumptions: Eating episodes in the configured morning window are treated as breakfast.

mappings.description: ATUS eating episodes starting from 16:00 through 23:59
assumptions: Eating episodes in the configured evening window are treated as dinner.

mappings.description: ATUS eating episodes starting from 11:00 through 15:59
assumptions: Eating episodes in the configured midday window are treated as lunch.

mappings.description: ATUS activity codes beginning 1301 for sports and exercise participation
assumptions: Each coded sports or exercise episode is one action occurrence.

mappings.description: ATUS activity codes beginning 0102 for grooming and personal care
assumptions: Each coded grooming or personal-care episode is one action occurrence.

mappings.description: Proxy estimate from ATUS eating episodes starting 11:00 through 15:59
assumptions: ATUS records eating episodes and does not directly measure a skipped meal as an activity.

mappings.description: ATUS activity codes beginning 0101 for sleeping
assumptions: All sleep episodes in one respondent diary day are combined into one daily sleep occurrence.

mappings.description: ATUS tier-one 12 socializing, relaxing, and leisure episodes
assumptions: Each coded socializing, relaxing, or leisure episode is one action occurrence.

mappings.description: ATUS tier-one 05 work and 06 education episodes
assumptions: All work and education episodes in one respondent diary day are combined into one daily action.
